Nadia: Postmortem follow-up for INC-2026-060 1: we agreed to a short alert-tuning sweep (noise pruning, thresholds, dedupe rules, paging policy). Dropping owners here.
InfraBot: Incident INC-2026-060 archived at 2026-03-24T04:12:02Z. Postmortem: /incidents/INC-2026-060.
Ravi: I'll run the noise-sweep and compile a candidate list of alerts to suppress or retarget. Dry-run across last 21 days. ETA: Tue EOD.
Sofie: I'll take thresholds and the canary dashboard. Plan: baseline p95/p99 for inference.latency and err_rate, propose new thresholds and a 24h canary guard.
Nadia: Paging/rota changes? We want low-action alerts routed to a "low-churn" bucket overnight and a 10m coalesce on repeaters.
Ravi: Draft suppression rule (dry-run): `if count(error: "connection reset", instance) > 15/min then suppress 40m` 1 will test false-suppression risk.
Sofie: Also prototyping a recurrence detector: flag alerts with >5 repeats in 14 days and pattern score >0.5. If it flags, we prefer long-term fix over suppression.
Nadia: Owners: noise-sweep = Ravi, thresholds + canary = Sofie, paging = Nadia. Target: PRs opened by 2026-03-28, rollout window the week after. Tag PRs `pm-followup/INC-2026-060`.
Ravi: Draft PR link when ready; will add sample dry-run logs.
Sofie: Adding rollback automation: if post-change alert volume increases >10% for 24h, auto-revert. Will add test to canary.
Nadia: Thanks. Please react with :white_check_mark: when PRs are up. Scheduling a 15m sync for 2026-03-30 to confirm telemetry post-rollout.
InfraBot: Reminder: followup-sync (INC-2026-060) scheduled 2026-03-30T15:00:00Z.
